name: unit-health
description: Unit Health CLI surface. Single source of truth for the `validate` domain: schema-validated against cli-manifest/v1 and cross-validated against the ValidationService proto descriptor at test time. Loaded by cli/main.go via cliapp.LoadFromManifest.

commands.name: scenario
commands.description: Validate a scenario's test execution, coverage, architecture, quality, and local test maturity

flags.name: path
flags.description: Filesystem path to validate instead of a scenario slug

flags.name: workspace
flags.description: Restrict validation to a workspace id (repeatable)

flags.name: execution
flags.description: Execute planned test commands (default: plan only)

omitted.reason: Shared cross-scenario validation surface exposed alongside this scenario's own ValidationService; the CLI 'validate scenario' command targets the scenario-local ValidationService.
